null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero

metric_definitions.daily_meal_volume: Meals served over a day; the same diner can contribute multiple meals.
metric_definitions.daily_entry_count: Entries or transactions over a day; entry counts need not equal meals consumed.
metric_definitions.daily_unique_student_count: Distinct students who entered during a day, counted once per student across meal periods.
metric_definitions.simultaneous_occupancy: People physically present at one time; requires occupancy data or entries and exits.
metric_definitions.service_capacity: Stated ability to serve meals; does not establish actual demand.
metric_definitions.popularity_share: A defined share of comparable campus dining activity; requires matching counts for other locations.

recommended_data_request.purpose: Establish average dining demand and student participation using observed records.
recommended_data_request.suggested_period: A complete recent teaching semester, with breaks, holidays and special events identified.

request_fields.description: Breakfast, lunch, dinner or late night, with period start and end times.
Aggregate entries or admissions, with the counting method documented.
Aggregate daily count of distinct students, deduplicated internally; no student identifiers requested.
Meals served if separately tracked, with the definition documented.
Separate main dining hall, Grab n Go, cafe and restaurant where applicable.
Optional 15- or 30-minute aggregate intervals for arrival patterns.
Weekday, weekend, holiday, break, special event or partial closure.

aggregation_rules: Average daily meals = sum of observed meals divided by included operating days.
Average unique students = sum of daily distinct student counts divided by included days.
Do not sum meal-period distinct student counts to obtain daily distinct students; the groups overlap.
Document whether closed days are included or excluded from each average.
Compare dining halls only over matching dates and outlet definitions.
